premises.text: Meetings often lack prepared agendas and waste significant time and resources
premises.evidence_span: 63% of the time, meetings do not have prepared agendas. It's estimated they waste $37 billion a year.

premises.text: People struggle to remember details and follow-up tasks from meetings
premises.evidence_span: Dave finds it hard to remember what happened in all of his meetings.

premises.text: Meeting details are often scattered across various platforms and formats
premises.evidence_span: Just like all of you, Dave's meeting details and content are scattered everywhere.

premises.text: Retrace provides a centralized mobile app for organizing meeting information
premises.evidence_span: Retrace is the best way to remember and organize everything about the meetings you've had.

premises.text: Retrace allows users to collaboratively document meetings and share information
premises.evidence_span: you can choose to collaboratively record everything that happened.

premises.text: Using Retrace improves preparation and efficiency for follow-up meetings
premises.evidence_span: Because you've used Retrace, everyone is better prepared and on the same page at the follow-up meeting.

premises.text: The go-to-market strategy involves bottom-up adoption and premium service offerings
premises.evidence_span: We want to bring value to the individual and drive adoption from the bottom up.

value.text: Retrace enhances meeting productivity and organization for users
value.evidence_span: helping you become a more productive person.

notes: No traction metrics or external partnerships were coded.
